title: Live Dune adapter and guarded core daily runner
objective: Make the audited core daily aggregate collector executable through the Dune CLI and a guarded local runner, without activating chain CA adapters or sending a live brief before independent audit GREEN.
owner_authorization: Owner authorized daily aggregate Dune collection, local PostgreSQL persistence, and Hermes delivery to 投研分析. This authorization covers aggregate-only Dune metrics for Solana, BSC, and Uniswap-scoped Robinhood; it does not activate BSC/Robinhood CA/RPC adapters, trading, or backfills. First multi-metric send remains gated on independent audit GREEN.
deliverables: A generic CoreDuneQueryGateway implementation that validates completed Dune responses and deterministic result hashes; an explicit CLI runner defaulting to dry-run and resolving the Hermes target in memory; focused tests with no real external calls.
forbidden_actions: Do not execute Dune, PostgreSQL, or Hermes during implementation tests.
Do not send the multi-metric brief before independent audit GREEN.
Do not read, print, store, or commit Dune keys, DATABASE_URL, target IDs, cookies, or raw provider payloads.
Do not modify project stage configuration or activate BSC/Robinhood CA/RPC adapters.
Do not add B3, R2, hourly profiles, Four.meme, stablecoin, bridge, TVL, FDV/market-cap, cohorts, backfills, signing, trading, or execution capability.
